front/idle: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animation sheet. D6 첫별의 갈매미맨: canonical round cream-white bird with dark slate-indigo feather arms, crest and back/tail plumage; beige gold beak/feet; angular beige-gold stone wings with dark indigo insets and gold four-point star ornaments; gold-trimmed dark indigo chest diamond with central gold star; gigantic dark indigo five-point star hovering overhead with thick gold edge and gold diamond tips, central gold four-point sparkle. Exact stone texture and feather anatomy, no new props. Exactly SIX complete sprite frames on 1536x1024 transparent canvas, 3 columns x 2 rows of equal 512px cells, row-major chronology. Intentionally SMALL sprites, each maximum 300px wide and 330px tall INCLUDING ALL wings/effects, with at least 90px empty safety space on all cell sides. Place each body at local center x256 and feet baseline y410. DO NOT enlarge sprites to fill cells. Fixed camera and identical body scale. Entire image must be true alpha cutouts; all empty pixels alpha=0, character interiors opaque. No floor, shadow, haze, outer glow, backdrop, lettering, grid lines, panels or border. Input 1 canonical FRONT, input 2 canonical BACK. Render FRONT viewpoint only matching input 1 throughout. Six poses: neutral, breathe in with slight star hover, blink, breathe out, settle, neutral seamless loop. Entire overhead star fits inside every cell with large margins; small isolated sprites.
